records.issue_text: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:5 resolves ENV_FILE="../.env" relative to the caller’s working directory rather than the script, modifying the parent directory’s .env when run from the repository root and leaving the application’s webhook configuration unchanged.
records.rationale: The script at scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh line 5 sets ENV_FILE="../.env" which is a relative path. When the script is executed, this path resolves relative to the current working directory of the caller, not the script's location.
